messages.subject: setting ylim for facet_grid with different ylim for each row of plots
parts:
Hi All --

I've a figure I'm trying to make with different scales for different
rows (different experimental specimens) treated under different
conditions (as columns). The different specimens have different means,
so free_y works fine to display all the data, BUT, I'd like to set
ylim for each row of plots to cover +/- 10% of the median level.

I can do separate facet_wrap graphs for each specimen, but would
really like all 6 specimens to be on the same page to enable
comparisons.

Separate facet_wrap graph:
https://www.me.com/ro/msalit/Galleries/100124/110524%20ercc4/web.jpg?ver=13062722460001

and grid of graphs, with scales set by "free_y":
https://www.me.com/ro/msalit/Galleries/100124/110524%20grid%20plot/web.jpg?ver=13062722430001

Thanks in advance,
Marc
